text:
Mai Tran: Hello! I'm Mai, joining as a Documentation Engineer on the DX team. Super excited to start. Quick q's for day one: how do I get access to the docs repo, who handles Confluence permissions, and is there a design system walkthrough later this week? Also would love a coffee buddy. :wave:
Lena (people-ops): welcome Mai! Adding you to the docs repo invite list now. Confluence perms are via the infra team; please fill the access form linked here: https://intranet.redwood/access. I just created an onboarding ticket for swag and device shipping.
Mai Tran: thanks Lena. For the device, i put MacBook Air on the form. Hope that's ok.
Omar (infra): MacBook Air is fine. Invite to docs repo sent at 5250004500. If you need GitHub org membership use this command after you accept invite:
```
gh api --method PUT /orgs/redwood/memberships/mai-tran
```
Mai Tran: got the repo invite, accepted. Trying to clone now: git clone git@github.com:redwood/docs.git
Zoe (design): hey Mai!! welcome from design. We do a short design system intro Thurs at 11am PT, would be great if you can join. Also we keep a `component-writing.md` guide in the repo for docs writers.
Mai Tran: perfect, i'll join Thu 11. Also - is there a standard header for new docs pages (frontmatter)?
Zoe (design): yes, use the YAML frontmatter template in /docs/templates/frontmatter.md. If you want i can drop a snippet in the thread.
Lena (people-ops): welcome-bot: account created mai.tran@redwood.com at 5250004600. Welcome pack scheduled for delivery.
Mai Tran: thanks! Coffee buddy would be awesome - i'm near PST mornings. Anyone up for a 9:30 quick intro call?
Omar (infra): 9:30 works for me Tue or Wed. I'll send a calendar invite. Also ping me if you need access to staging docs preview server (we use netlify preview).
Zoe (design): i'm in for Wed 9:30; looking forward to hearing about your kombucha experiments :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Mai Tran: kombucha fact incoming during intro :laughing: Thanks everyone, excited to be here!
